name: Manifold Sample
description: Demo consumer mod for Manifold. Registers void + flat + dark + streaming + vault (separate-inventory) dimensions with travel policies and the /voiddim, /flatdim, /darkdim, /streamdim, /vaultdim, /overworlddim, /sendtestitem, /sendtestblock, /createtempdim and /destroytempdim commands, plus a portal block.
